require 'json'; require 'digest'; require 'fileutils'; require 'open3'
d=File.expand_path(__dir__); base=File.expand_path('../split-owner-transfer-v1-2026-10-27',d)
out=d+'/dense-controls';raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(out);FileUtils.mkdir_p(out)
r={status:'running',runner_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(__FILE__).hexdigest,rows:[],semantics:[],sources:{},identities:{}}
[base,d].each{|root|r[:identities][root]=Digest::SHA256.file(root+'/task-allocation-probe').hexdigest}
r[:binary_sha256]=Digest::SHA256.file(d+'/candidate-kujo').hexdigest
save=->{File.write(out+'/report.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 [128,8192,16384].each do |n|
  dir=out+"/#{n}";FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir)
  declarations=(0...n).map{|i|"mut k#{i} := #{i}\n"}.join
  writes=(0...n).map{|i|"k#{i} += 1\nsum += k#{i}\n"}.join
  source="export func factory() {\n#{declarations}func step() { mut sum := 0\n#{writes}return sum }\nreturn step }\n"
  raise 'Source exceeds parser bound' if source.bytesize>1048576
  File.write(dir+'/owner.kujo',source);r[:sources][Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(source)]=source
  [1,4].each do |calls|
   initial=n*(n-1)/2
   main="from owner import factory\nlet f := factory()\nlet independent := factory()\nmut i := 0\nwhile i < #{calls} { i += 1 assert_equal(f(), #{initial} + #{n} * i) }\nlet alias := f\nassert_equal(alias(), #{initial+n*(calls+1)})\nassert_equal(independent(), #{initial+n})\nprint(\"DENSE PASS\")\n"
   path=dir+"/calls-#{calls}.kujo";File.write(path,main);r[:sources][Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(main)]=main
   %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
    row={bindings:n,calls:calls,mode:mode,source_sha256:Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(main),module_sha256:Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(source)}
    {baseline:base,candidate:d}.each do |label,root|
     stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(root+'/task-allocation-probe',mode,path)
     raise stdout+stderr unless status.success? && stdout=="DENSE PASS\n"
     counts=stderr.match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/);raise stderr unless counts
     row[label]={requests:counts[1].to_i,bytes:counts[2].to_i}
    end
    r[:rows]<<row;save.call
   end
   %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
    args=[d+'/candidate-kujo','run',path,'--untrusted'];args<<'--'+mode unless mode=='vm'
    stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);raise stdout+stderr unless status.success? && stdout=="DENSE PASS\n"
    r[:semantics]<<{bindings:n,calls:calls,mode:mode,exit:status.exitstatus};save.call
   end
  end
 end
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].size==12 && r[:semantics].size==18
 raise 'Dense allocation regression' unless r[:rows].all?{|x|[:requests,:bytes].all?{|m|x[:candidate][m]<=x[:baseline][m]}}
